response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS fielding_count FROM fielding AS f JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), hand_stats AS (SELECT batting_hand, fielding_count, SUM(fielding_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(fielding_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT batting_hand, fielding_count, 1.0 * fielding_count / total_count AS share, fielding_count - average_count AS above_average FROM hand_stats WHERE fielding_count > average_count
